correctness.rationale: For each distinct symbol pair both aba and bab need at least three traversals of the undirected pair edge in a nontrivial covering circle; each aaa needs two loop traversals. Euler parity of nonloop degrees forces q/2 extra traversals for even q. An expanded Euler circuit of K_q with loops and, for even q, one duplicated perfect matching proves attainability. The proof is all-q; independent construction and integer programming confirmed small cases.
